description: This file defines the class ZipSalesServices which provides services for importing zip sales tax data and calculating sales taxes based on zip codes, cities, and rules. It includes methods for importing tax tables, performing flat tax calculations, and retrieving relevant tax entries.

classes.name: ZipSalesServices
classes.description: Provides services for importing zip sales tax data and calculating sales taxes based on zip codes, cities, and rules.

methods.name: importFlatTable
methods.description: Imports zip sales tax tables and rules from specified XML data files into the database, with security checks and error handling.

methods.name: flatTaxCalc
methods.description: Calculates applicable sales tax adjustments for a list of items based on shipping address and available tax data.

methods.name: getItemTaxList
methods.description: Assistive private method that retrieves and calculates tax adjustments for individual items based on zip code, city, and applicable rules.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Utility method for parsing date strings into Timestamps with default fallback.
